_meta.doctrine: dumped from the live Python loaders after the boot sequence

absolute_destruction.description: Unleash catastrophic damage in a massive area, obliterating everything.
absolute_destruction.name: Absolute Destruction
absolute_destruction.narrative: Subtlety is for people who can't level mountains.

alchemists_insight.description: Gain extra time for your alchemy mini-game and increase potion quality.
alchemists_insight.name: Alchemist's Insight
alchemists_insight.narrative: The brew reveals its secrets to those patient enough to watch. And lucky enough to not explode.

anglers_patience.description: Slow down the expansion of ripples, giving you more time to click accurately.
anglers_patience.name: Angler's Patience
anglers_patience.narrative: The patient angler understands that rushing yields nothing but empty nets and broken lines.

arctic_cone.description: Blast of freezing wind in a cone that slows and freezes enemies
arctic_cone.name: Arctic Cone
arctic_cone.narrative: Exhale winter itself. A cone of absolute zero flash-freezes everything before you, leaving your enemies slowed or frozen solid.

battle_fury.description: Dramatically increase attack damage and speed simultaneously.
battle_fury.name: Battle Fury
battle_fury.narrative: Rage is a weapon. Control it, channel it, unleash it.

battle_stance.description: Brace yourself against incoming attacks, reducing damage taken significantly.
battle_stance.name: Battle Stance
battle_stance.narrative: Plant your feet. Lower your center. Become the immovable object.

bountiful_harvest.description: Gather extra materials from each resource node you harvest.
bountiful_harvest.name: Bountiful Harvest
bountiful_harvest.narrative: The generous earth rewards those who know where to look. And how to ask nicely.

chain_harvest.description: Gather from multiple resource nodes in a small area simultaneously.
chain_harvest.name: Chain Harvest
chain_harvest.narrative: Why harvest one at a time when you can harvest all of them?

chain_lightning.description: Lightning that jumps between enemies, shocking each target
chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.narrative: A single bolt becomes many. Watch as lightning leaps from foe to foe, each target convulsing as the shock spreads through the battlefield.

combat_rush.description: Attack much faster for a short burst of time.
combat_rush.name: Combat Rush
combat_rush.narrative: Precision is overrated when you can just hit them twelve times before they blink.

combat_strike.description: Your next attack hits with devastating force, dealing massive damage.
combat_strike.name: Power Strike
combat_strike.narrative: Sometimes subtlety fails. Sometimes you just need to hit something really, really hard.

enchanters_grace.description: Gain increased chance for perfect enchantment patterns and rarity upgrades.
enchanters_grace.name: Enchanter's Grace
enchanters_grace.narrative: Magic flows where intention directs it. Unless you sneeze. Then it flows everywhere.

endless_bounty.description: Gain massive bonus materials from every gather for an extended period.
endless_bounty.name: Endless Bounty
endless_bounty.narrative: The earth provides for those who know its secrets. And sometimes, it just really likes you.

engineers_precision.description: Extend engineering puzzle time and improve device quality significantly.
engineers_precision.name: Engineer's Precision
engineers_precision.narrative: Complex mechanisms demand careful attention. Rush the gears, get your fingers caught.

field_medic.description: Instantly restore a moderate amount of health.
field_medic.name: Field Medic
field_medic.narrative: Bandages are for people with time. This is for people who don't.

fishers_strength.description: Strengthen your grip and increase hit tolerance, making it easier to land catches.
fishers_strength.name: Fisher's Strength
fishers_strength.narrative: A strong arm and steady hand can wrestle even the most stubborn fish from the depths.

fortunes_favor.description: Massively increase critical chance and rarity for all actions.
fortunes_favor.name: Fortune's Favor
fortunes_favor.narrative: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity. This is what happens when luck meets steroids.

gravity_well.description: Create a point of intense gravity that pulls and crushes all nearby foes
gravity_well.name: Gravity Well
gravity_well.narrative: Bend space itself to your will. A singularity forms at your target, pulling enemies inward before crushing them with arcane force.

keen_eye.description: Significantly increase critical hit chance for all actions.
keen_eye.name: Keen Eye
keen_eye.narrative: See the weaknesses others miss. Strike where it matters most.

lucky_catch.description: Increase your chances of catching rare and legendary fish.
lucky_catch.name: Lucky Catch
lucky_catch.narrative: Fortune favors the prepared. Or maybe the fish just like you better.

lumberjacks_rhythm.description: Fall into a steady rhythm, chopping wood much faster than normal.
lumberjacks_rhythm.name: Lumberjack's Rhythm
lumberjacks_rhythm.narrative: Listen to the forest. Find the heartbeat. Match your swing to the ancient pulse.

master_angler.description: Channel your mastery of the waters, boosting all fishing abilities significantly.
master_angler.name: Master Angler
master_angler.narrative: The waters recognize you as one of their own. All who dwell within answer your call.

master_craftsman.description: Dramatically boost crafted item quality and gain massive rarity upgrade chance.
master_craftsman.name: Master Craftsman
master_craftsman.narrative: Mastery isn't a destination. It's a standard you refuse to compromise.

meteor_strike.description: Call down a meteor that devastates an area and ignites all enemies
meteor_strike.name: Meteor Strike
meteor_strike.narrative: You tear a fragment from the heavens itself. The meteor crashes down with the fury of a dying star, leaving nothing but scorched earth and burning foes.

miners_fury.description: Channel raw strength into your pickaxe, doubling mining damage for a sustained period.
miners_fury.name: Miner's Fury
miners_fury.narrative: The mountain yields to those who show it proper respect. Or, failing that, overwhelming force.

omega_strike.description: A single attack of unimaginable power that ignores defenses and deals catastrophic damage.
omega_strike.name: Omega Strike
omega_strike.narrative: One strike. One chance. One ending.

phoenix_resurrection.description: Continuously regenerate massive health and repair equipment durability.
phoenix_resurrection.name: Phoenix Resurrection
phoenix_resurrection.narrative: From ashes, rise. From wounds, strength. Death is merely an inconvenience.

quick_repair.description: Instantly restore durability to your equipped tools and weapons.
quick_repair.name: Quick Repair
quick_repair.narrative: A warrior who maintains their tools never finds themselves defenseless.

reality_breach.description: Temporarily ignore all tier restrictions and requirements. Use any tool on any material, craft at any station.
reality_breach.name: Reality Breach
reality_breach.narrative: Rules are for people who lack imagination. And sufficient mana reserves.

refiners_touch.description: Improve your refining mini-game time and material quality output.
refiners_touch.name: Refiner's Touch
refiners_touch.narrative: Impurities burn away when you know exactly how hot, exactly how long.

regenerative_aura.description: Slowly restore health over time while active.
regenerative_aura.name: Regenerative Aura
regenerative_aura.narrative: Wounds close. Bones knit. Given enough time, everything heals.

second_wind.description: Restore health and mana simultaneously when you need it most.
second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.narrative: You're not done yet. Get up.

shadow_beam.description: Piercing beam of darkness that weakens all it touches
shadow_beam.name: Shadow Beam
shadow_beam.narrative: A lance of pure darkness tears through reality. Those touched by the void find their strength sapped, their attacks feeble.

smiths_focus.description: Extend your smithing mini-game timer, giving more time for perfect strikes.
smiths_focus.name: Smith's Focus
smiths_focus.narrative: Master smiths don't rush. They breathe. They focus. They strike true.

sprint.description: Move significantly faster for a brief period.
sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.narrative: Sometimes the best strategy is running away. Fast.

time_dilation.description: Massively extend all mini-game timers, giving you all the time you need.
time_dilation.name: Time Dilation
time_dilation.narrative: Time is relative. Especially when you're cheating.

tool_preservation.description: Your tools consume durability much more slowly.
tool_preservation.name: Tool Preservation
tool_preservation.narrative: A well-maintained tool is an investment. A broken tool is an expensive lesson.

treasure_sense.description: Dramatically increase the chance of finding rare materials while gathering.
treasure_sense.name: Treasure Sense
treasure_sense.narrative: Some call it luck. Some call it intuition. Mostly it's just knowing where to dig.

vampiric_aura.description: Aura that drains life from all nearby enemies
vampiric_aura.name: Vampiric Aura
vampiric_aura.narrative: Become the void. An aura of darkness surrounds you, leeching the life force from all who dare come close. Their pain is your healing.

waters_blessing.description: The waters bless your efforts, potentially granting bonus catches.
waters_blessing.name: Water's Blessing
waters_blessing.narrative: Those who respect the waters are rewarded with abundance.

whirlwind_strike.description: Attack all enemies in a wide radius around you.
whirlwind_strike.name: Whirlwind Strike
whirlwind_strike.narrative: Spin. Strike. Repeat. Simple tactics are often the deadliest.
